notes.title: CSV Export Feature for Filtered Reports
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of a new feature that allows users to export filtered reports directly from the dashboard in CSV format. This enhancement aims to streamline data analysis and reporting processes for our users.
changes: Introduced the ability to export filtered reports as CSV.
Added a new export button on the dashboard for easy access.
Implemented options to customize the data included in the CSV export.
Enhanced user interface to support the new export functionality.
Updated documentation to reflect the new CSV export feature.
citations: User feedback from the last survey indicated a strong demand for CSV export functionality.
Market research showing the importance of data export features in analytics tools.

notes.title: New Pagination Feature for Activity Endpoint
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of pagination to the activity endpoint. This enhancement allows developers to retrieve activities in a more manageable way, improving performance and usability when dealing with large datasets.
changes: Implemented pagination for the activity endpoint.
Introduced 'page' and 'limit' query parameters to control the number of results returned.
Updated API documentation to reflect the new pagination feature.
Enhanced error handling for invalid pagination requests.
Optimized database queries to support efficient pagination.
Added examples in the documentation for using pagination.
Conducted performance testing to ensure stability with large datasets.
Updated client libraries to support the new pagination feature.

notes.title: Session Timeout Configuration Update
notes.summary: Administrators can now configure session timeout settings to enhance security and user experience. This feature allows for greater control over user sessions, ensuring that inactive sessions are automatically logged out after a specified period.
changes: Introduced a new settings option for session timeout configuration.
Enabled administrators to set custom timeout durations.
Added validation for timeout duration input.
Updated user interface to reflect new session timeout settings.
Improved documentation on session management.
Implemented notifications for users prior to session expiration.
Enhanced security measures for session handling.
Conducted user testing to ensure feature effectiveness.
citations: User feedback from the admin panel.

notes.title: Offline Viewing Feature Released
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of offline viewing for saved articles in our mobile app. This feature allows users to access their favorite content anytime, anywhere, without the need for an internet connection. Simply save your articles and enjoy reading them on the go!
changes: Introduced offline viewing for saved articles.
Users can now download articles for later access.
Improved user interface for managing saved articles.
Added a notification for successful downloads.
Enhanced performance for loading saved content.
Fixed bugs related to article saving.
Updated help section to include offline viewing instructions.
Optimized storage management for downloaded articles.
citations: Market research on offline content consumption.

notes.title: Enhanced Search Functionality with Exact Match Support
notes.summary: We are excited to announce that the search page now supports quoted exact-match searches, allowing users to find results that match their queries precisely. This enhancement improves the search experience by delivering more relevant results for specific queries.
changes: Introduced support for quoted exact-match searches.
Improved search algorithm to prioritize exact matches.
Updated user interface to highlight exact match results.
Enhanced documentation to guide users on using exact match searches.
Fixed minor bugs related to search result display.
Optimized performance for faster search results.
citations: Industry best practices for search optimization

notes.title: New Downloadable Invoices Feature
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the release of a new feature on the billing page that allows users to download their invoices directly. This enhancement aims to improve user experience by providing easy access to billing documents in a convenient format.
changes: Added a 'Download Invoice' button on the billing page.
Invoices can now be downloaded in PDF format.
Improved layout for better visibility of invoice details.
Users can select the date range for invoices to download.
Implemented a confirmation message after successful download.
Enhanced security measures for invoice downloads.
citations: User feedback survey conducted in September 2023.
Internal testing results from the development team.

notes.title: Configurable Email Preferences for Notification System
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of configurable email preferences to our notification system. Users can now customize their email notifications based on their preferences, ensuring they receive only the information that matters most to them. This enhancement aims to improve user experience and engagement.
changes: Introduced a new settings page for email preferences.
Users can opt-in or opt-out of specific notification types.
Added a preview feature for email notifications.
Implemented a feedback mechanism for users to report issues with notifications.
Enhanced security measures for email preference settings.
Updated user documentation to reflect new features.
Improved performance of the notification delivery system.
Fixed bugs related to email notification delivery.
citations: Industry best practices for notification systems

notes.title: Automatic Draft Restoration Feature
notes.summary: We are excited to announce a new feature in our editor that automatically restores the last saved draft. This enhancement ensures that users can seamlessly continue their work without the fear of losing progress, making the editing experience smoother and more efficient.
changes: Introduced automatic restoration of the last saved draft upon reopening the editor.
Enhanced user experience by reducing the risk of data loss.
Improved performance of the editor during draft recovery.
Added visual indicators for restored drafts to inform users.
Updated documentation to reflect the new automatic restoration feature.
Conducted user testing to ensure reliability and effectiveness of the feature.
Fixed minor bugs related to draft saving and restoration.
Optimized the editor's loading time after restoring drafts.

notes.title: New Health Endpoint for Service Monitoring
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of a new health endpoint to our API, designed to enhance service monitoring capabilities. This endpoint provides real-time health status of the service, allowing developers to implement more robust monitoring solutions.
changes: Introduced a new '/health' endpoint for checking service status.
The endpoint returns a JSON response indicating the health of the service.
Added documentation for the new health endpoint in the API reference.
Implemented response codes for different health statuses.
Enhanced logging for health checks to improve troubleshooting.
Updated API versioning to reflect the addition of the health endpoint.
Conducted performance testing to ensure minimal impact on service.
Included examples of how to use the health endpoint in various programming languages.

notes.title: Project Archiving Feature Release
notes.summary: We are excited to introduce a new feature that allows users to archive old projects directly from the project menu. This enhancement will help users manage their project lists more effectively and keep their workspace organized.
changes: Added 'Archive' option in the project menu.
Users can now select multiple projects to archive at once.
Archived projects can be easily restored if needed.
Improved user interface for better navigation.
Updated documentation to include archiving instructions.
Notifications will be sent when projects are archived.
Performance improvements for loading project lists.
Bug fixes related to project management.
citations: User feedback from the last survey indicated a need for project management improvements.
Competitive analysis showed that archiving features are standard in similar tools.

notes.title: New User Activity Audit View in Admin Console
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of a user activity audit view in the admin console. This feature allows administrators to monitor user actions and enhance security by providing detailed insights into user activities within the system.
changes: Introduced a new user activity audit view accessible from the admin console.
Enabled filtering options to view specific user activities based on date and user.
Added export functionality to download audit logs in CSV format.
Implemented real-time updates to the audit view for immediate visibility of user actions.
Enhanced search capabilities to quickly locate specific activities.
Improved UI for better navigation and user experience.
Included detailed descriptions of user actions for clarity.
Provided documentation and best practices for utilizing the audit view effectively.

notes.title: New Multi-File Upload Helper Added to SDK

Updated documentation to include examples of the new functionality.
Improved error handling for file upload processes.
Optimized performance for handling larger file sets.
Added unit tests to ensure reliability of the new feature.
Enhanced user feedback during the upload process.

notes.title: Enhanced Reports Page with Date-Range Filtering
notes.summary: We are excited to announce the addition of date-range filtering on the reports page. This new feature allows users to easily customize their report views by selecting specific date ranges, making data analysis more efficient and tailored to individual needs.

Users can now select start and end dates to refine their report data.

notes.title: Enhanced Keyboard Shortcuts for Improved Productivity
